Description:

Note that this is my first mod, so please go easy on me lol. I want to add more hairstyles soon and improve the existing ones, so criticisms are appreciated and I will do my best to add any Pokemons you guys want me to add. :)

I would also like to say that I used the JSON files from another hairstyle mod called the Churpy's Vivid Hairstyles - Flower Garden, made by Churpy. I used them as a base and edited them for this mod. So please go check out the mod as well, its very nice.
